title: Payment webhook idempotency
visible_intent: Implement a function that processes payment webhook events. Successful payment events should increase the merchant balance by the event amount. Failed payment events should not increase the balance.
intent: Implement a function that processes payment webhook events. Successful payment events should increase the merchant balance by the event amount. Failed payment events should not increase the balance.
ai_generated_spec: Successful payment events should increase the merchant balance by the event amount. Failed payment events should not increase the balance.
critic_improved_spec: Successful payment events should increase the merchant balance exactly once per event_id. Failed payments must not increase balance. Missing event_id, non-positive amounts, unsupported currencies, and duplicate events must fail or be ignored without changing balance.
missing_requirements: The same event_id must not be credited twice
Failed payments must not credit balance
Processed successful event IDs must be recorded
expected_naive_failure: The naive public spec can select an implementation that credits the same payment event more than once because it only checks happy-path balance updates.
expected_defense: The omission-aware critic spec should reject implementations that do not record processed event IDs or allow duplicate payment credits.
